title: Core primary logical source promotions
summary: This iteration promotes reviewed core-primary official source candidates into reader-visible logical sources, making Apple ML Research, Meta Engineering, NVIDIA AI Developer, and xAI News visible in the public source graph while preserving the 154-entry collection inventory.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "core primary official logical source promotions" tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "core primary official logical source promotions|Anthropic Research logical source promotion|source display contract governance|source-first IA contract|source inventory order reference|source-first IA dashboard|source inventory|source map scan index|source order tuning review" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Order-tuning candidates should be removed as soon as they become executable logical sources.
lessons.evidence: `content-apple-machine-learning`, `content-meta-engineering`, `content-nvidia-developer-blog`, and `content-xai-news` are removed from the future-candidate review table after promotion.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future promotion PRs paired with order-tuning review updates and replacement candidates.

lessons.lesson: A source-first promotion can map more than one collection entry when readers see a single source identity.
lessons.evidence: `content-xai-news` and `content-xai-company-news` now map to `xai-news`, while both remain visible as separate collection inventory entries.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue grouping same-identity official subchannels when it improves reader clarity without hiding collection entries.

followups.action: Promote the next reviewed batch from `docs/source-order-tuning-review.md`, likely China model platform sources or durable paper/model ecosystem sources.
